events.title: October Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in and around Old Fort. Gateway trails do not allow e-bikes. Foothills Watershed does allow e-bikes. Post-ride social at Foothills Watershed. All riders must sign up through Eventbrite. For all women 18 and older.

events.title: Beers + Maintenance | Trailside Tune Up
events.description: Hands-on clinic with Daily Cycle AVL covering shifting issues, chain problems, brake rubbing, and valve issues. Check in 4:30-5pm. Drink token and snack provided. Rain or shine event. Bring trail tools. For all women 18 or older.

events.title: Test + Tune with Cane Creek Components (Again)
events.description: Suspension test and tune with Cane Creek Components. For riders with suspension bikes comfortable on downhill trails with rocks and roots. Meet at Explorer Loop parking lot. Does not allow e-bikes. For all women 18 or older. 8 spots available.

events.title: November Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in Pisgah and DuPont. Neither location allows e-bikes. Post-ride social at Oskar Blues Brewery. All riders must sign up through Eventbrite. For all women 18 and older.

events.title: December Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in Hot Springs. This location does not allow e-bikes. Post-ride social at Big Pillow Brewing. All riders must sign up through Eventbrite. For all women 18 and older.
